title: bindables
description: makes a button in pause menu to swap between keybind layouts quickly
body:
Mod Description: Bindables
Bindables is a utility mod for Minecraft (Fabric) that allows you to create, manage, and switch between multiple Keybinding Loadouts. Whether you need different controls for PvP, building, or technical play, Bindables makes it easy to swap your entire keyboard configuration with a single click.
Key Features
Create Multiple Loadouts: Save your current keybindings into named profiles.
Easy Access: Access the "Keybind Loadouts" menu directly from the Pause Menu (Esc) while in-game.

Full Loadout Management:
S (Save/Update): Quickly update an existing loadout with your current settings.

R (Rename): Give your loadouts descriptive names to keep them organized.

X (Delete): Remove loadouts you no longer need.

Instant Application: Clicking a loadout name immediately applies those settings to your game.
Persistent Storage: All loadouts are saved in your Minecraft config folder (bindables_loadouts.json), so they persist across game sessions.

Technical Details
Platform: Fabric
Minecraft Version: 1.21.11
Requirements: Fabric API, Java 21, Fabric Loader 0.17.2+
